newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Branson says knew competition would be weak.
newsitem.headline: Branson says knew competition would be weak.

text.p: British entrepreneur Richard Branson said on Tuesday he knew competition for his fledgling Virgin Express low-cost regional airline would be weak.
"We always knew the competition was weak or we wouldn't have come into the market," Branson told Reuters at the official launch of the airline's new Brussels-Copenhagen link.
He said there were currently no other low-fare airlines competing with Virgin Express in Europe but that there would be room for one or two similar carriers in the region
Branson launched Brussels-based Virgin in April after buying 90 percent of EuroBelgian Airlines SA (EBA). It operates 14 Boeing 737 aircraft.
